name: Conventions lists the extracted candidates with verified evidence and honest counters
description: Walks the read-only half of L02 on seeded data: the sidebar entry (the only nav item whose href carries :repoId besides Pull Requests, so it also proves repo-token resolution), the scan meta line, the two counters that make the list credible, and one card of each kind. The point of the flow is the pair of assertions on confidence: one card says '312 of 343 places follow this' (a counted adherence) and another says the model's own estimate is all there is (no matcher) — that distinction is the product claim of the whole feature, and nothing else in the suite covers it. Also asserted: the dropped-candidates line, because a list of three with no context reads as 'this repo has three conventions' rather than 'seven were proposed and four could not be substantiated'; and the not-cloned warning shown ALONGSIDE the candidates, since the seeded demo repo has clonePath: null — a repo that cannot be scanned right now must still show the triage it already has. Evidence locations are asserted as `path:start-end` because those line numbers are the ones the verifier corrected, and they are what the GitHub deep-link is built from. Accept and Deselect all ARE exercised, because they are the only writes on this screen that leave no trace once undone: the flow accepts one candidate, checks the counter, then clears the triage and checks it is back to zero — so the seeded stack ends as it started. Deliberately NOT asserted: running a scan (it would need a clone, an index and a model call) and skill generation (a write that would persist) — all of those live in the server integration tests and the client unit tests. Precondition: a freshly seeded DB (npm run e2e:hermetic), which seeds one finished scan over acme/payments-api with three candidates.
